details:
Astronaut Health Monitoring Software

Develop a software application that monitors astronauts' physical and psychological health during long-duration space missions.

The application will:

  • Monitor Health: Track heart rate, blood pressure, bone and muscle health, sleep, and stress.
  • Monitor Radiation: Use NASA datasets to track radiation exposure and detect dangerous solar events.
  • Assess Risks: Analyze health measurements, identify unusual changes, and detect potential health risks.
  • Provide Alerts: Notify astronauts of concerning health changes and offer scientifically supported recommendations.

Goal: Transform NASA scientific data and astronaut health measurements into an intelligent monitoring system that helps protect astronauts during long-duration space missions.
